source_title: 개꿀팁) 하이잘 도착하면 사제들 꼭 해야할 일....TIP
subtitle: 하이잘 절벽에서 사제가 꼭 해야 할 일 — 정신 지배 + 공손한 인사

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
하이잘 도착하면
사제가 꼭 해야 할
개꿀팁 알려줄게~
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder (OTS) diagonal shot from behind the aviator goggles and pigtails of the Gnome Rogue in foreground-right. Looking toward the Night Elf Priest girl on the left, who holds her glowing crescent staff upright, smiling serenely with closed eyes and holding up one finger to share a secret tip beside the dizzying height of the Hyjal mountain peak. Lower two-thirds framing, top 35% pure white (#FFFFFF) headroom. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
정신 지배~
자, 예의 바르게
인사부터 해야지?
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle shot looking up at the Night Elf Priest girl casting Mind Control, hands outstretched with hypnotic swirly pink-and-purple psychic rings radiating from her glowing eyes and palms, wearing an innocent sweet yet terrifying smile. In front of her, the Orc Warrior stands with eyes swirling in a hypnotic trance, woodenly raising one hand to /bow. Staff stowed on Priest's back. Positioned on the left, leaving generous pure white (#FFFFFF) space on right 46% for dialogue bubble. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
어... 어어...?
몸이 멋대로...
발밑이 없는데?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dutch-tilt slapstick action camera with a dizzying steep cliff angle! The Orc Warrior is mind-controlled into walking right off the edge of a floating stone cliff, one foot stepping into empty air! Her jaw drops in hysterical terror, eyes bulging with tears, arms flailing frantically while her legs keep marching forward robotically! Lower two-thirds framing, top 35% pure white (#FFFFFF) headroom. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

High-angle shot looking down at the Gnome Rogue girl in a signature comedic freeze-frame, completely wordless. Watching the mind-controlled victim plummet from the cliff, her aviator goggles slide down her nose, jaw unhinged to the floor in horrified disbelief, cold sweat drops pouring down like a shower, shivering uncontrollably at the Priest's cruelty. Centered dramatic framing filling ~78% of canvas height. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
잘 가요~
인사까지 했으니
매너 플레이 맞죠?
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile 90-degree action shot of the Night Elf Priest girl standing at the cliff edge on the left, leaning forward gracefully and waving a delicate white handkerchief goodbye into the abyss with a radiant angelic smile and sparkling halos. Lunar crescent staff resting beside her on the ground. Lower two-thirds framing, top 35% pure white (#FFFFFF) headroom. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
악마를 보았다...
근데 도적은 혼란
딸깍이면 되는데?
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view shot seen from behind of the Gnome Rogue backing away in slow stealth toward the left, turning her back to the serene Priest, whispering sideways with wide traumatized eyes and sweatdrops. In the background-right, the Priest calmly dusts her robes off. Clean framing leaving generous pure white (#FFFFFF) space on the right 46% for dialogue bubble. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.
